youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用徒步情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從山腳步道口看地圖、辦許可證、檢查裝備，到上坡歇腳、喝水補給、問難度，再到岔路迷途、風景打卡、天氣突變躲雨，最後登頂拍照、下山膝蓋痠痛、回家煮泡麵、約下次再出發，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Hiking a Trail phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the trailhead map and permit, gear checks, steep climbs with water and rest breaks, a lost fork in the trail, scenic photo stops and sudden rain, then reaching the summit, a sore-kneed descent, hot noodles at the car and planning the next hike. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the start of the trail?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪs ðɪs ðə stɑrt əv ðə treɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡是步道的起點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look for the big wooden sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, lʊk fər ðə bɪɡ ˈwʊdən saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，找那塊大木頭指示牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, beside the parking lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz, bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 在那兒，停車場旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let's walk over and read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, lɛts wɔk ˈoʊvər ænd rid ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們過去看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This map shows three different routes.
dialogue.zh: 這張地圖顯示三條不同的路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one is the easy green line?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn ɪz ði ˈizi ɡrin laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一條是簡單的綠色線？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green line is the shortest loop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin laɪn ɪz ðə ˈʃɔrtəst lup./
dialogue.zh: 綠色線是最短的一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long does that loop take?
dialogue.zh: 那一圈要走多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours if you walk slow.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走的話兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for our first day out.
dialogue.zh: 很適合我們第一次出來走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I want the blue route to the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ wɑnt ðə blu rut tu ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 可是我想到山頂那條藍色路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is five hours, are you sure?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz faɪv ˈaʊərz, ɑr ju ʃʊr?/
dialogue.zh: 那條要五小時，你確定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try the blue route today.
dialogue.zh: 今天就試藍色那條吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, then we start early.
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們早一點出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you happen to know the time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈhæpən tu noʊ ðə taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 你知道現在幾點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's seven fifty, almost time.
dialogue.zh: 七點五十分，快到點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a permit for this trail?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə ˈpərˌmɪt fər ðɪs treɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 這條步道需要許可證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, get one at the ranger desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɡɛt wʌn æt ðə ˈreɪndʒər dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 要，到管理員台拿一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ranger desk open already?
dialogue.zh: 管理員台已經開了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It opens at eight, ten minutes more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊpənz æt eɪt, tɛn ˈmɪnɪts mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 八點才開，還要等十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll go stand in that short line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡoʊ stænd ɪn ðæt ʃɔrt laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我去那條短隊伍排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get two permits, one for each.
dialogue.zh: 拿兩張許可證，一人一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does one permit cost?
dialogue.zh: 一張許可證多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only five dollars for a person.
dialogue.zh: 一個人只要五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by credit card there?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ baɪ ˈkrɛdɪt kɑrd ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那裡可以刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash is better, the signal is bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ɪz ˈbɛtər, ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ɪz bæd./
dialogue.zh: 用現金比較好，那邊訊號差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have exact change in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ɪɡˈzækt tʃeɪndʒ ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我口袋裡有剛好的零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're all set for that.
dialogue.zh: 那付款就沒有問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we write our names?
dialogue.zh: 我們的名字要寫在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the card at the back of the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə kɑrd æt ðə bæk əv ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 寫在台子後面那張單子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to show an ID too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tu ʃoʊ ən aɪˈdi tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我們也要出示證件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just the time you leave here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, dʒʌst ðə taɪm ju liv hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 不用，只要寫離開的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's check your backpack.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們來檢查你的背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, open it up for me.
dialogue.zh: 好，你幫我打開看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have water, snacks, and a jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv ˈwɔtər, snæks, ænd ə ˈdʒækɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你有水、點心和外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did I forget anything important?
dialogue.zh: 我有沒有忘記重要的東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring a small first aid kit.
dialogue.zh: 要帶一個小包急救用品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's already in the side pocket.
dialogue.zh: 它已經在側邊口袋裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many bottles of water do we need?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑtəlz əv ˈwɔtər du wi nid?/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要幾瓶水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two big bottles for each person.
dialogue.zh: 每一個人兩大瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll fill mine at the tap there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɪl maɪn æt ðə tæp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我去那邊的水龍頭裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's clean, you can drink it.
dialogue.zh: 那裡的水很乾淨，可以直接喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these boots okay for climbing?
dialogue.zh: 這雙靴子適合爬坡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soles have good grip, wear those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə soʊlz hæv ɡʊd ɡrɪp, wɛr ðoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 鞋底很防滑，就穿這雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tug the knot tight again.
dialogue.zh: 再把結拉緊一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose laces make you fall.
dialogue.zh: 鞋帶鬆了容易跌倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear the thick socks?
dialogue.zh: 我該穿厚襪子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they stop blisters on your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ stɑp ˈblɪstərz ɑn jɔr fit./
dialogue.zh: 要，可以避免腳上起水泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put sunscreen on your face now.
dialogue.zh: 防曬乳記得擦臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How often should I put on more?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɔfən ʃʊd aɪ pʊt ɑn mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我多久要補擦一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every two hours in the sun.
dialogue.zh: 在太陽底下每兩小時補一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take the whole bottle with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, teɪk ðə hoʊl ˈbɑtəl wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 來，整瓶都帶去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I really need a hat up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ˈrɪli nid ə hæt ʌp ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 上面真的需要戴帽子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cold wind will hurt your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊld wɪnd wɪl hərt jɔr hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 山上冷風吹了會頭痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grab the thin white one from my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb ðə θɪn waɪt wʌn frʌm maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 從我包裡拿那頂薄白帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one has a string, it won't fly off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn hæz ə strɪŋ, ɪt woʊnt flaɪ ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 這頂有繩子，不會被吹走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the restroom before we start?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈrɛˌstrum bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 出發前的洗手間在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind the map, next to the trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ðə mæp, nɛkst tu ðə triz./
dialogue.zh: 地圖後面，樹的那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll only take a minute or two.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈoʊnli teɪk ə ˈmɪnɪt ɔr tu./
dialogue.zh: 我只花一兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll watch the bags right here.
dialogue.zh: 我就在這裡顧背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget the small trash bag.
dialogue.zh: 別忘了那個小垃圾袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In my pocket, we carry everything out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt, wi ˈkæri ˈɛvriθɪŋ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 在我口袋裡，垃圾我們全都帶下山。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the weather good for today?
dialogue.zh: 今天的天氣好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunny now, clouds come later.
dialogue.zh: 現在是晴天，雲後來才會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do the clouds arrive?
dialogue.zh: 雲大概幾點進來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around three in the afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 大約下午三點左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we must be down by then.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi məst bi daʊn baɪ ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 所以那個時間前我們得下山。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we turn back at the top flag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi tərn bæk æt ðə tɑp flæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 對，到了山頂旗就往回走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have your phone charged?
dialogue.zh: 你的手機充好電了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fully charged, with a power bank too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʊli ˈtʃɑrdʒd, wɪð ə ˈpaʊər bæŋk tu./
dialogue.zh: 充滿了，也帶了行動電源。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you download the trail map?
dialogue.zh: 你能先下載步道地圖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done already, it works with no signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɔlˈrɛdi, ɪt wɜrks wɪð noʊ ˈsɪɡnəl./
dialogue.zh: 已經好了，沒訊號也能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What number do we call if lost?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈnʌmbər du wi kɔl ɪf lɔst?/
dialogue.zh: 迷路時我們打哪個號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine one one, then show them the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn wʌn wʌn, ðɛn ʃoʊ ðɛm ðə koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 打九一一，再把代碼給他們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's that code on the sign?
dialogue.zh: 那個代碼在地圖牌的哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom right corner, small black letters.
dialogue.zh: 右下角，很小的黑字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My backpack feels too heavy now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在覺得背包太重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me carry the water part.
dialogue.zh: 水的部分讓我來背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adjust these straps on your shoulders.
dialogue.zh: 調一下你肩上的背帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? Now it sits better.
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？現在舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trail starts just past that gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪl stɑrts dʒʌst pæst ðæt ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 步道在那個柵欄後面開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close it behind us, keep bears out.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs, kip bɛrz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 在我們身後關好，避免熊進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are bears really out here?
dialogue.zh: 這一帶真的有熊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rare, but we make noise walking.
dialogue.zh: 很少見，但我們走路要弄出聲響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we carry a little bell?
dialogue.zh: 我們該帶一個小鈴噹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, clip it on the front strap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, klɪp ɪt ɑn ðə frʌnt stræp./
dialogue.zh: 要，夾在前面的帶子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's set a walking pace now.
dialogue.zh: 我們先決定好走路的速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow and steady, no running today.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢穩穩走，今天不要跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay behind me on the narrow parts.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ bɪˈhaɪnd mi ɑn ðə ˈnɛroʊ pɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 路段窄的地方請跟在我後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll watch my step.
dialogue.zh: 好，我會注意腳下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many rest stops are on the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni rɛst stɑps ɑr ɑn ðə weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 路上有幾個休息點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four benches and one small hut.
dialogue.zh: 四張長椅和一座小木屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a shop inside that hut?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ʃɑp ɪnˈsaɪd ðæt hʌt?/
dialogue.zh: 那座木屋裡面有小賣部嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They sell tea and warm soup there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ sɛl ti ænd wɔrm sup ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那裡有賣茶和熱湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll save money for soup.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我留錢買湯喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And bring some coins for tea too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd brɪŋ səm kɔɪnz fər ti tu./
dialogue.zh: 也帶些硬幣用來買茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, we're ready to start hiking.
dialogue.zh: 好了，我們可以開始徒步了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One last look at the route map.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst lʊk æt ðə rut mæp./
dialogue.zh: 出發前最後看一眼地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The first marker is above those trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fərst ˈmɑrkər ɪz əˈbʌv ðoʊz triz./
dialogue.zh: 第一個標記就在那些樹的上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's go, it's a good day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts ɡoʊ, ɪts ə ɡʊd deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們走吧，今天是好日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The path goes straight up now.
dialogue.zh: 現在的路直接往上陡升。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then small steps, keep your balance.
dialogue.zh: 那就走小步，保持平衡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs already feel tired.
dialogue.zh: 我的腿已經覺得累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal after twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 走了二十分鐘後這很平常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much farther to the first bench?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈfɑrðər tu ðə fərst bɛntʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 到第一張長椅還有多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just past that big bent tree.
dialogue.zh: 就在那棵彎了的大樹後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stop and drink some water?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi stɑp ænd drɪŋk səm ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能停下來喝點水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the bench is right there.
dialogue.zh: 可以，長椅就在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me the bottle, I'm thirsty.
dialogue.zh: 把水壺給我，我渴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink slowly, don't gulp it all.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢喝，別一口氣全喝光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have cold water left?
dialogue.zh: 你還有冷水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's warm now, the sun heated it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wɔrm naʊ, ðə sʌn ˈhitɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 現在變溫了，被太陽曬熱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm water is fine, I'll take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈwɔtər ɪz faɪn, aɪl teɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 溫水也可以，我喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, one more sip before we move.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, wʌn mɔr sɪp bɪˈfɔr wi muv./
dialogue.zh: 來，再喝一小口才走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How hard is the rest of the climb?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ hɑrd ɪz ðə rɛst əv ðə klaɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 剩下的上坡有多難？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two steep hills, then it's easy.
dialogue.zh: 還有兩道陡坡，之後就好走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those hills longer than this one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðoʊz hɪlz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ðɪs wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 那兩道坡比這道更長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but the view pays for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, bʌt ðə vju peɪz fər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 長一點，但風景很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a real break, not just sipping.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ə ril breɪk, nɑt dʒʌst ˈsɪpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我需要真正的休息，不只是喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take ten minutes, we have time.
dialogue.zh: 休息十分鐘吧，我們來得及。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you time ten minutes for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju taɪm tɛn ˈmɪnɪts fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我計時十分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, and it will ring.
dialogue.zh: 設十分鐘，時間到會響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart is beating so fast.
dialogue.zh: 我的心跳得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand still and breathe out deep.
dialogue.zh: 站著別動，深深地吐氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we eat something right now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在要吃點東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a cookie will help you.
dialogue.zh: 要，一塊餅乾會讓你舒服些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have the peanut ones you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ðə ˈpinʌt wʌnz ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我有你愛吃的花生口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always pack the best snacks.
dialogue.zh: 你總是帶最好吃的零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This salt makes me want more water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs sɔlt meɪks mi wɑnt mɔr ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 這個鹹味讓我更想喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save the last bottle for the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðə læst ˈbɑtəl fər ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 最後一瓶留到山頂再喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know how steep this grade is?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju noʊ haʊ stip ðɪs ɡreɪd ɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 你知道這段坡度有多陡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sign said twenty here.
dialogue.zh: 牌子上這一區寫二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty feels like much more to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti filz laɪk mʌtʃ mɔr tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得二十的坡度遠不止。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean forward and use your poles.
dialogue.zh: 身體前傾，用登山杖撐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These poles really help my knees.
dialogue.zh: 登山杖真的幫到我的膝蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use them on the way down too.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðɛm ɑn ðə weɪ daʊn tu./
dialogue.zh: 下山的時候也要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do fallen leaves get slippery here?
dialogue.zh: 落葉踩起來會不會滑？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the wet ones, watch them.
dialogue.zh: 只有濕的那種會滑，小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoe slid on those brown leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃu slɪd ɑn ðoʊz braʊn livz./
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋在那些落葉上滑了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step where the dirt is bare.
dialogue.zh: 踩在沒有葉子的泥地上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's rest again at that bench.
dialogue.zh: 我們到那張長椅再休息一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks nice, under the tall pines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks naɪs, ˈʌndər ðə tɔl paɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 看起來很舒服，在高松樹下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bench is warm from the sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɛntʃ ɪz wɔrm frʌm ðə sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這張長椅被太陽曬得溫熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, your back needs some warmth.
dialogue.zh: 剛好，你的背需要點溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long did we sit this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dɪd wi sɪt ðɪs taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這次我們坐了多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only eight minutes, still early.
dialogue.zh: 才八分鐘，時間還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let's walk a little more up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts wɔk ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 那我們再往上走一點吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll lead this part now.
dialogue.zh: 好，這一段換我帶路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have shade ahead?
dialogue.zh: 前面還有陰涼的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the next hill is all open.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə nɛkst hɪl ɪz ɔl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，下一道坡完全沒有遮擋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I need my hat and sunscreen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ nid maɪ hæt ænd ˈsʌnˌskrin./
dialogue.zh: 那我需要帽子和防曬乳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both are in the top pocket.
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都在最上面那個口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wind here is actually strong.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的風其實很強。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds the rain away for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz ðə reɪn əˈweɪ fər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它暫時把雨雲吹走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't see the path from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt si ðə pæθ frʌm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 從這裡我看不見路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for the blue marks on stones.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fər ðə blu mɑrks ɑn stoʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 找找石頭上的藍色標記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One blue mark, I see it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn blu mɑrk, aɪ si ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一個藍色標記，我看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then walk straight to that rock.
dialogue.zh: 那就直接朝那塊石頭走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I going too fast for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu fæst fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我是不是走得太快了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, slow down, please.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，慢一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I walk fast whenever I'm excited.
dialogue.zh: 我一興奮就會走快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me and I'll match your speed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ænd aɪl mætʃ jɔr spid./
dialogue.zh: 跟我說，我就配合你的速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My chest feels tight when I climb.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʃɛst filz taɪt wɛn aɪ klaɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我一爬胸口就發悶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop, rest, and breathe through your nose.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp, rɛst, ænd brið θru jɔr noʊz./
dialogue.zh: 先停下休息，用鼻子呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better after a minute of that.
dialogue.zh: 那樣做一分鐘後好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two minutes, we're not racing.
dialogue.zh: 休息兩分鐘吧，我們不是在比賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this trail hard for new hikers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs treɪl hɑrd fər nu ˈhaɪkərz?/
dialogue.zh: 這條路對新手來說難嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beginners do it, but with rests.
dialogue.zh: 新手也走得了，只是要多歇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a shorter route be smarter?
dialogue.zh: 改走短一點的路線會不會更聰明？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're halfway, keep going a bit.
dialogue.zh: 我們已經一半了，再撐一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halfway up, I can't believe it.
dialogue.zh: 竟然已經爬到一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hard part is mostly behind us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɑrd pɑrt ɪz ˈmoʊstli bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 難走的大半在我們後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the second hill harder than this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsɛkənd hɪl ˈhɑrdər ðæn ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 第二道坡比這裡更難走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's longer but much gentler.
dialogue.zh: 不，比較長但平緩得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gentler sounds great to me now.
dialogue.zh: 聽到平緩我就放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then save your energy for later.
dialogue.zh: 那就把力氣留到後面用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to share an energy bar?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt tu ʃɛr ən ˈɛnərdʒi bɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 你想分一根能量棒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the chocolate one, please.
dialogue.zh: 好，巧克力的那一根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take half, I broke it already.
dialogue.zh: 拿一半去，我已經掰開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, sugar helps on these climbs.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，爬這種坡很需要糖分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a spring water stop up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə sprɪŋ ˈwɔtər stɑp ʌp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 上面有一個泉水補給點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's refill our bottles there then.
dialogue.zh: 那我們到那裡把水壺裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is spring water safe to drink?
dialogue.zh: 泉水可以直接喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sign says it's tested weekly.
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫每週都有檢測。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bottle is empty already.
dialogue.zh: 我那瓶已經空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine has two sips left.
dialogue.zh: 我那壺只剩兩口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drink yours now, I'll fill up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɪŋk jʊrz naʊ, aɪl fɪl ʌp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你那兩口先喝，到那裡我再補水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver on this hill.
dialogue.zh: 在這道坡上你真是救星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look down, we came from there!
dialogue.zh: 往下看，我們是從那裡走上來的！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see our car way down there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn si ɑr kɑr weɪ daʊn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我看到我們的車遠在下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks so small from up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks soʊ smɔl frʌm ʌp hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 從上面看下去它好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit and enjoy this for a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ænd ˌɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðɪs fər ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 坐下來，好好欣賞一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your feet still hurting?
dialogue.zh: 你的腳還痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one toe, there's a blister.
dialogue.zh: 只有一個腳趾，那裡起水泡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop here, I have blister bands.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡停，我有水泡貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, clean it first with water.
dialogue.zh: 正好，先用水把它沖乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you stand up and walk again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju stænd ʌp ænd wɔk əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 你能站起來再走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels much better already.
dialogue.zh: 可以，已經好很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next stop is that small hut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst stɑp ɪz ðæt smɔl hʌt./
dialogue.zh: 下一站是那座小木屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can wait out the wind there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi kæn weɪt aʊt ðə wɪnd ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 好，我們可以在那裡避風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two paths here, which one is ours?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pæθz hɪr, wɪtʃ wʌn ɪz ˈaʊərz?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有兩條路，哪一條是我們的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm not sure, the sign is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm nɑt ʃʊr, ðə saɪn ɪz ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 我也不確定，指示牌不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gone? How can a sign be gone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɔn? haʊ kæn ə saɪn bi ɡɔn?/
dialogue.zh: 不見了？牌子怎麼會不見？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wind took it, look at the post.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd tʊk ɪt, lʊk æt ðə poʊst./
dialogue.zh: 被風吹走了，你看那根柱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The post is empty, that's bad.
dialogue.zh: 柱子上空空的，情況不妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay calm, we still have the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ kɑm, wi stɪl hæv ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 先冷靜，我們還有地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone shows no signal here.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機在這裡沒有訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The saved map still works offline.
dialogue.zh: 存好的地圖離線也能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which line are we standing on?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在站在哪一條線上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dotted gray one, near the fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑtəd ɡreɪ wʌn, nɪr ðə fɔrk./
dialogue.zh: 灰色虛線那條，就在岔路口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we need the left path, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi nid ðə lɛft pæθ, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們該走左邊那條，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, go right and climb a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɡoʊ raɪt ænd klaɪm ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不對，往右再爬一小段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we already pass that right turn?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi ɔlˈrɛdi pæs ðæt raɪt tərn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們是不是已經錯過那個右轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, back ten minutes, that's all.
dialogue.zh: 是的，往回走十分鐘而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We must walk all the way back?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mʌst wɔk ɔl ðə weɪ bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要走那麼遠的回頭路？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's easy going, it slopes down.
dialogue.zh: 回去好走，那是往下傾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe ask those people coming down?
dialogue.zh: 也許可以問問那些下山的人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, wave them over now.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，現在跟他們揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, does this go to the top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi, dəz ðɪs ɡoʊ tu ðə tɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這條路通到山頂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They say yes, but take the right fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ seɪ jɛs, bʌt teɪk ðə raɪt fɔrk./
dialogue.zh: 他們說是，但要走右邊岔路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the right fork marked clearly?
dialogue.zh: 右邊那條有清楚標記嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three stone piles on it.
dialogue.zh: 有，沿路有三個石堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for telling us.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ fər ˈtɛlɪŋ ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 非常感謝你們告訴我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They say the view is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ seɪ ðə vju ɪz wərθ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他們說那段風景很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are the stone piles, look!
dialogue.zh: 石堆就在那裡，你看！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We found it, I feel better now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi faʊnd ɪt, aɪ fil ˈbɛtər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們找到了，我現在安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's remember this fork going down.
dialogue.zh: 下山時要記得這個岔路口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tie a ribbon on the branch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl taɪ ə ˈrɪbən ɑn ðə bræntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我要在樹枝上綁一條緞帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that allowed, leaving marks here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡留標記是可以的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Park rules say take everything back.
dialogue.zh: 園區規定要一併帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then no ribbon, just watch the stones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ ˈrɪbən, dʒʌst wɑtʃ ðə stoʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 那就別綁緞帶，專心看石堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, and count the blue marks too.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, ænd kaʊnt ðə blu mɑrks tu./
dialogue.zh: 同意，也數一下藍色標記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're back on route, the map agrees.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr bæk ɑn rut, ðə mæp əˈɡriz./
dialogue.zh: 我們回到正確路線，地圖也對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the trail opens up wide.
dialogue.zh: 現在步道變得好寬闊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a huge view of the valley!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ə hjuːdʒ vju əv ðə ˈvæli!/
dialogue.zh: 看，整個山谷在眼前！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the famous photo spot.
dialogue.zh: 這裡就是那個著名拍照點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you take my picture here?
dialogue.zh: 你能在這裡幫我拍張照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, stand by that flat rock.
dialogue.zh: 可以，站在那塊平石頭旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Isn't that too near the edge?
dialogue.zh: 那不會太靠近邊緣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One step back, perfect. Say cheese!
dialogue.zh: 退一步，很好，說起司！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it! Now it's your turn.
dialogue.zh: 拍好了！現在換你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same rock? It really suits me.
dialogue.zh: 同一塊石頭？那兒很適合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but smile, you look stiff.
dialogue.zh: 好，但要笑，你看起來好僵硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now send them to our family group.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ sɛnd ðɛm tu ɑr ˈfæməli ɡrup./
dialogue.zh: 現在把它們傳到家族群組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No signal here, we'll send them from the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈsɪɡnəl hɪr, wil sɛnd ðɛm frʌm ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒訊號，回車上再傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's ninety photos for one trail.
dialogue.zh: 一條步道就拍了九十張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light here is perfect for shots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt hɪr ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt fər ʃɑts./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的光線最適合拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then one more in front of that tree.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn mɔr ɪn frʌnt əv ðæt tri./
dialogue.zh: 那就到那棵樹前面再拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are done, let's eat now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ɑr dʌn, lɛts it naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的腿沒力了，我們先吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This bench is clean, sit right down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɛntʃ ɪz klin, sɪt raɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 這張長椅很乾淨，直接坐下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought sandwiches with cheese inside.
dialogue.zh: 我帶來夾起司的三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I kept the warm soup in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ kɛpt ðə wɔrm sup ɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我這裡還留著保溫的熱湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You brought hot soup? You're the best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju brɔt hɑt sup? jʊr ðə bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 你帶了熱湯？你太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in the silver bag, help yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪn ðə ˈsɪlvər bæɡ, hɛlp jɔrˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 在銀色袋子裡，自己拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have cups for the soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv kʌps fər ðə sup?/
dialogue.zh: 我們有杯子可以裝湯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two paper ones folded flat.
dialogue.zh: 有兩個壓扁的紙杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This soup tastes like heaven right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs sup teɪsts laɪk ˈhɛvən raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這碗湯現在喝起來像天堂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat slow, your hands are shaking.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吃，你的手還在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the bread, I'll save it for later.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə brɛd, aɪl seɪv ɪt fər ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 麵包留著，我想之後再吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's getting cold, eat it while warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɡɛtɪŋ koʊld, it ɪt waɪl wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 天氣變涼了，趁熱吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long did we sit and eat?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dɪd wi sɪt ænd it?/
dialogue.zh: 我們坐著吃了多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, we still can make it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts, wi stɪl kæn meɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，我們還來得及。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see those dark clouds behind us?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju si ðoʊz dɑrk klaʊdz bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 你看到後面那片烏雲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and moving fast this way.
dialogue.zh: 看到了，正朝這邊快速移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wasn't the forecast sunny all day?
dialogue.zh: 預報不是說整天晴天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mountains make their own weather.
dialogue.zh: 山上的天氣就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we run or walk to the hut?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi rʌn ɔr wɔk tu ðə hʌt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要跑向木屋還是快走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk quick, don't run on wet rocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk kwɪk, doʊnt rʌn ɑn wɛt rɑks./
dialogue.zh: 快走就好，別在濕石頭上跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain is already falling on my arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈfɔlɪŋ ɑn maɪ ɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 雨點已經落在我的手臂上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get your coat on and cover the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt jɔr koʊt ɑn ænd ˈkʌvər ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 把雨衣穿上，蓋住背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But this thin jacket soaks right through.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðɪs θɪn ˈdʒækɪt soʊks raɪt θru./
dialogue.zh: 但這件薄外套一下就濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come here, share my big coat instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm hɪr, ʃɛr maɪ bɪɡ koʊt ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 過來，跟我共穿一件大雨衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the hut far from this spot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hʌt fɑr frʌm ðɪs spɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 木屋離這個地方遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, just follow the red posts.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts, dʒʌst ˈfɑloʊ ðə rɛd poʊsts./
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，跟著紅色柱子走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't see posts in this rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt si poʊsts ɪn ðɪs reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這場雨裡我看不見柱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look low, they're painted bright red.
dialogue.zh: 往低處看，柱子漆得很鮮紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's one, and the roof over there!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz wʌn, ænd ðə ruf ˈoʊvər ðɛr!/
dialogue.zh: 看到一根了，屋頂也在那邊！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run the last short stretch now.
dialogue.zh: 最後一小段快跑過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're inside, dry at last.
dialogue.zh: 我們進屋了，終於乾爽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on that bench, it's covered here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ðæt bɛntʃ, ɪts ˈkʌvərd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 坐到那張椅子上，這裡不漏雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on the menu in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ɑn ðə ˈmɛnju ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的菜單上有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot tea, coffee, and canned food.
dialogue.zh: 有熱茶、咖啡和罐頭食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cups of hot tea, that's what we need.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps əv hɑt ti, ðæts wʌt wi nid./
dialogue.zh: 兩杯熱茶，正是我們要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you take sugar in yours?
dialogue.zh: 你那杯要加糖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a little, I want to taste tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈlɪtəl, aɪ wɑnt tu teɪst ti./
dialogue.zh: 只要一點，我想喝茶的原味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, hold the cup with both hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, hoʊld ðə kʌp wɪð boʊθ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 來，兩手捧著杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers were too cold to move.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz wɜr tu koʊld tu muv./
dialogue.zh: 我的手指冷到無法動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm tea fixes that in minutes.
dialogue.zh: 喝熱茶幾分鐘就暖回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the rain getting heavier outside?
dialogue.zh: 外面的雨變大了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's thinning, look at the sky.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪts ˈθɪnɪŋ, lʊk æt ðə skaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，雨變小了，看天空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's blue already behind the clouds.
dialogue.zh: 雲層後面已經露出藍色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it five, then we walk out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt faɪv, ðɛn wi wɔk aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 再等五分鐘，我們就出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave our wet bags inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi liv ɑr wɛt bæɡz ɪnˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們的濕背包可以放在屋裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the ranger says that's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə ˈreɪndʒər sɛz ðæts faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 要管理員說可以才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says we can go now, sun's out.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz wi kæn ɡoʊ naʊ, sʌnz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 他說我們可以走了，太陽出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, a rainbow above the trees!
dialogue.zh: 你看，樹的上方有彩虹！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One quick photo of that rainbow.
dialogue.zh: 趕快為那道彩虹拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it from the deck, it's wider.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt frʌm ðə dɛk, ɪts ˈwaɪdər./
dialogue.zh: 從木平台上拍，視野更寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the trail beyond here all downhill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə treɪl bɪˈjɑnd hɪr ɔl ˈdaʊnˌhɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 過了這裡的路全往下坡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but one last climb to the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli, bʌt wʌn læst klaɪm tu ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 大致是，但到山頂還得爬一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're at the top, we made it!
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr æt ðə tɑp, wi meɪd ɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 我們到山頂了，成功了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look all around, you did it.
dialogue.zh: 看看四周，你真的做到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole valley is under us.
dialogue.zh: 整個山谷就在我們腳下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the sea is far to the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə si ɪz fɑr tu ðə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 右邊很遠的地方還能看到海。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's take a photo beside the flag.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ bəˈsaɪd ðə flæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我們在旗子旁邊拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and write the date on the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd raɪt ðə deɪt ɑn ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 好，還在木板上寫日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should I write the date?
dialogue.zh: 日期要怎麼寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Month, day, and this year.
dialogue.zh: 月、日，再加上今年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you sign our names too?
dialogue.zh: 你也幫我們的名字寫上去好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write small, right next to yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl raɪt smɔl, raɪt nɛkst tu jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 我寫小一點，就在你旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How cold is it up here?
dialogue.zh: 山上面有多冷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The board says only four degrees.
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫只有四度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four degrees? Put another layer on.
dialogue.zh: 四度？再穿一層衣服吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wear gloves too, my hands freeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl wɛr ɡlʌvz tu, maɪ hænz friz./
dialogue.zh: 我也要戴手套，手快凍僵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we stay long at the summit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi steɪ lɔŋ æt ðə ˈsʌmɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們在山頂待很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then we descend.
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，而後下山。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That word, descend, means going down?
dialogue.zh: 那個詞是指往下走的意思嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's a formal way to say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪts ə ˈfɔrməl weɪ tu seɪ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，那是比較正式的說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to sit and do nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tu sɪt ænd du ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我想坐著，什麼都不做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This stone wall makes a good seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs stoʊn wɔl meɪks ə ɡʊd sit./
dialogue.zh: 這道石牆當座位剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far away can you really see?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr əˈweɪ kæn ju ˈrɪli si?/
dialogue.zh: 你最多可以看到多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can see three mountains away.
dialogue.zh: 可以看到三座山以外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel so proud right now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在真的好驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You climbed it without giving up.
dialogue.zh: 你一路爬上來，沒有放棄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's eat the last cookies here.
dialogue.zh: 最後的餅乾我們在山頂吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, summit cookies taste better.
dialogue.zh: 好，山頂吃餅乾格外香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have enough water for going down?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv ɪˈnʌf ˈwɔtər fər ˈɡoʊɪŋ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 下山的水還夠用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost a full bottle, we're fine.
dialogue.zh: 差不多還滿一瓶，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we start down right away?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在就要下山嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's light now, dark by five.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪts laɪt naʊ, dɑrk baɪ faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 要，現在還亮，五點就天黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knees already hurt going down.
dialogue.zh: 才往下走我的膝蓋就痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend them softly, use your poles.
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋保持微彎，用登山杖撐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The downhill is faster than up.
dialogue.zh: 下坡比上山路快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But it's harder on your toes.
dialogue.zh: 不過腳趾承受的力更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My big toe keeps hitting the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɪɡ toʊ kips ˈhɪtɪŋ ðə frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 我的大腳趾一直撞到鞋頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tighten them, that stops the slide.
dialogue.zh: 收緊鞋帶就不會往前滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, now I feel no pressure.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，現在不覺得壓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set your foot flat, not hard.
dialogue.zh: 腳掌輕輕放平，別重踩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These stones move under my feet.
dialogue.zh: 這些石頭在我腳下會滑動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step beside them, not on top.
dialogue.zh: 踩在它們旁邊，別踩上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I slipped but caught myself.
dialogue.zh: 我滑了一下，不過穩住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Were you holding your poles then?
dialogue.zh: 那時候你握著登山杖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one pole saved my fall.
dialogue.zh: 有，一根杖讓我沒摔下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plant both poles before each step.
dialogue.zh: 每一步前先把兩根杖撐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pass the fork on the way down?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi pæs ðə fɔrk ɑn ðə weɪ daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 下山會經過那個岔路口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep to the blue marks again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kip tu ðə blu mɑrks əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 會，再認準那些藍色標記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, we found our turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz, wi faʊnd ɑr tərn./
dialogue.zh: 就在那裡，我們找到了轉彎處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left path this time, straight down.
dialogue.zh: 這次走左邊那條，一路往下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt is wet and cold now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃərt ɪz wɛt ænd koʊld naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的上衣現在又濕又冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, use the dry one from my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, juz ðə draɪ wʌn frʌm maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 來，用我包裡那件乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll change behind those tall grasses.
dialogue.zh: 我到那叢高草後面換。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll face the other way for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl feɪs ði ˈʌðər weɪ fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 我背對著這邊幫你遮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is the parking lot now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɪz ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在離停車場還有多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one mile past the big rock.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt wʌn maɪl pæst ðə bɪɡ rɑk./
dialogue.zh: 過大石頭大約還有一英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One mile sounds far to me.
dialogue.zh: 一英里聽起來好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's all downhill, you'll fly there.
dialogue.zh: 全是下坡，你一下子就到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I walk in front for a while?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɔk ɪn frʌnt fər ə waɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 讓我先在前面走一會兒好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just wait for me at forks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, dʒʌst weɪt fər mi æt fɔrks./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，只要在岔路口等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are shaking again.
dialogue.zh: 我的腿又開始抖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's from all those steep steps.
dialogue.zh: 那是因為下了太多陡台階。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a shortcut to the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈʃɔrtˌkʌt tu ðə roʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 有抄近路到馬路的方法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No shortcuts, stay on this trail.
dialogue.zh: 沒有捷徑，留在這條步道上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least the sun came back.
dialogue.zh: 至少太陽又出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dries our wet sleeves fast.
dialogue.zh: 很快就把我們濕潤的袖子烤乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you smell the river near here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju smɛl ðə ˈrɪvər nɪr hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你聞到附近河水的味道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cross it at the wooden bridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi krɔs ɪt æt ðə ˈwʊdən brɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我們從那座木橋過河。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bridge steady with two of us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə brɪdʒ ˈstɛdi wɪð tu ʌv ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們兩人走這座橋穩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One at a time, then the next.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn æt ə taɪm, ðɛn ðə nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 一次過一個人，再換下一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water is right under those boards.
dialogue.zh: 那些木板下面就是水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't look down, hold the rail.
dialogue.zh: 別往下看，抓緊欄杆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm across, come over slow.
dialogue.zh: 我過來了，你慢慢過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rail is wet but I'm fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə reɪl ɪz wɛt bʌt aɪm faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 欄杆是濕的，但我沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My whole foot went in the stream.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hoʊl fʊt wɛnt ɪn ðə strim./
dialogue.zh: 我整只腳都踏進溪水中。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry it well before you walk on.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ɪt wɛl bɪˈfɔr ju wɔk ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 繼續走之前先把它擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can dry at the car instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn draɪ æt ðə kɑr ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以到車上再弄乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, ten more minutes there.
dialogue.zh: 好計畫，再十分鐘就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My backpack strap cuts my shoulder.
dialogue.zh: 背包帶勒得我肩膀好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to me for the last part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt tu mi fər ðə læst pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 最後一段我幫你背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You already carried all the water.
dialogue.zh: 妳已經背了全部的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arms are strong, don't worry.
dialogue.zh: 我手臂有力氣，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear cars, that's the road!
dialogue.zh: 我聽到車聲，那是馬路！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can see the parking lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi kæn si ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們已經看到停車場了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, our car beside the big sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ɑr kɑr bəˈsaɪd ðə bɪɡ saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 看，我們的車就在那個大牌子旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My feet are so glad to see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit ɑr soʊ ɡlæd tu si ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的腳看到它就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the signal is back, send photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ɪz bæk, sɛnd ˈfoʊtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 現在有訊號了，把照片傳出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sending them to the family group.
dialogue.zh: 正在傳到家族群組裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are shaking, you find it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænz ɑr ˈʃeɪkɪŋ, ju faɪnd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我手在抖，你來找鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in my other jacket pocket.
dialogue.zh: 在我另一件外套的口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, hop in, doors open.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，快上車，門開好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the warm air on, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把暖氣打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs feel like jelly now.
dialogue.zh: 我的腿現在軟得像果凍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them, we won't drive yet.
dialogue.zh: 先讓腿休息，我們還不急著開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have cold drinks?
dialogue.zh: 我們還有涼的飲料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two teas in the box, take them.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tiz ɪn ðə bɑks, teɪk ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 箱子裡還有兩瓶茶，拿去喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow these muscles will hurt.
dialogue.zh: 明天這些肌肉一定會痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stretch tonight, it helps a lot.
dialogue.zh: 今晚先拉筋，很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight we cook hot noodles.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們煮熱騰騰的泡麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With two eggs and some green onions.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪθ tu ɛɡz ænd səm ɡrin ˈənjənz./
dialogue.zh: 加兩顆蛋和一些蔥花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same trail again next week?
dialogue.zh: 下週同一條步道再去一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's book the mountain hut first.
dialogue.zh: 我們先把山上木屋訂好。
